config.dataset: Crypto Daily Panel (57 liquid digital assets)

data_provenance.price_definition: 00:00 UTC daily Spot close (Binance 1d kline close)
data_provenance.base_sample: 2017-08-17 to 2023-11-05 (2,272 days) across 57 Binance Spot USDT pairs (SHA-256 e919b8d5...)
data_provenance.extension_sample: 2023-11-06 to 2023-12-31 (56 days) fetched via Binance public REST API (/api/v3/klines, symbol={TICKER}USDT, interval=1d, close k[4]); overlapping rows through 2023-11-05 are unchanged

terminal_missing_series_2023.TOMO: Last valid close 2023-11-20 (41 missing days): Binance delisted TOMOUSDT for TomoChain -> Viction (VIC) rebranding/swap
terminal_missing_series_2023.PERL: Last valid close 2023-12-07 (24 missing days): Binance delisted PERLUSDT Spot pairs
terminal_missing_series_2023.BUSD: Last valid close 2023-12-15 (16 missing days): Binance ceased BUSDUSDT Spot support after Paxos wind-down

data_provenance.missing_value_handling: Assets with missing prices inside the 30-day lookback window are excluded from signal/hedge weights; for held-position valuation and simple-return benchmarks, missing terminal prices are forward-filled (0% return after delisting) as an accounting convention, not evidence of executable fills

config.interpretation: Historical replication on a retrospectively selected crypto universe, not a fresh holdout. Zero-delay variants assume idealized execution at the signal close. Gross returns omit fees, funding and borrow costs.

sharpe: Arithmetic mean daily portfolio return divided by sample standard deviation, annualized by sqrt(365.25); zero cash rate
uncertainty_method: Fixed-length 30-day circular block bootstrap (2,000 resamplings); quantifies sample variability without establishing cross-regime stationarity
benchmark_methodology: 100% long simple-return fixed-weight portfolios (Large-Cap Crypto Index: 62% BTC / 26% ETH / 12% across 8 large-caps [XRP, LTC, LINK, XLM, ADA, ATOM, EOS, TRX]; Core Crypto Index: 70% BTC / 30% ETH; Bitcoin: 100% BTC)

changes: Market hedge universe observed at decision date
Explicit entry, rebalance and liquidation costs
limitations: Historical sample already used by source project
Idealized same-close execution in zero-delay variants
Funding, borrow fees and availability excluded
Missing prices carried forward for valuation, not evidence of executable fills
Dollar-neutral weights do not imply market-beta neutrality
Fixed-length 30-day circular block bootstrap does not by itself prove stability across all regimes
